profile.name: 仿真场景组件
profile.description: 这是一个非物理软件组件，用于定义、编译、初始化和更新仿真场景。它管理场景规格、实体、传感器、地形、多环境布局及共享传感上下文，并可将场景 XML 与网格资源导出到目录或压缩包，供实验或机器人仿真使用。
profile.description_en: This is a non-physical software component for defining, compiling, initializing, and updating a simulation scene. It manages scene specifications, entities, sensors, terrain, multi-environment layout, and shared sensor context, and can export scene XML and mesh assets to a directory or archive for laboratory or robotics simulation use.

registry.name: Configuration for a simulation scene
registry.description: Scene是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、初始化、复位。支持Signal, Slot, compile等操作。
